clue.text: What's said when one's due to be cuddled by future partner

definitions.text: What's said when one's due to be cuddled by future partner

indicators.note: being cuddled means being wrapped in someone's arms, so these letters sit inside the partner's

parts.note: a groom is a man about to be married
ETA, estimated time of arrival, is when someone is due

explanation.surface: A couple canoodling in public as one arrives, prompting the classic jibe.
explanation.walkthrough: The whole clue is both the wordplay and the definition: the arrival time hugged by the bridegroom pictures the very cuddling that draws the remark.
explanation.definitionFit: A jokey idiom said to a couple showing too much affection in public, telling them to take it somewhere private.

clue.text: It's driven tooth upwards, colliding with craft

indicators.note: in a down entry, going upwards means the word is read from the bottom, backwards

parts.note: a cog is a tooth on a gear wheel
art is skill or craft

explanation.surface: A vehicle whose gear tooth is crunching into a boat.
explanation.walkthrough: 'colliding with' just sets the two pieces side by side.
explanation.definitionFit: A go-kart is a small motor vehicle that a person drives, often for racing.

clue.text: Pushy parent ultimately spreading disease

indicators.note: ultimately points to the final letter of the word parent
spreading scatters the letters of pushy into a new arrangement

explanation.surface: An overbearing parent who ends up passing on an illness.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Pushy parent' reads as a single phrase, but Pushy is the anagram fodder and parent only gives its final T.
explanation.definitionFit: Typhus is an infectious fever spread by lice and fleas, so it is a disease.

clue.text: Object forcefully as her allies crumbled

indicators.note: something crumbled falls to pieces, so the letters of her allies are broken up and rebuilt

explanation.surface: Someone protests angrily when her friends let her down.
explanation.walkthrough: 'as' is only a link; the fodder is just 'her allies'.
explanation.definitionFit: To kick up a fuss or complain loudly and angrily is an idiom for objecting with force.

clue.text: Joined item in bedroom — it won't happen again!

parts.note: two things joined together become as one
a nightstand is a bedside table

explanation.surface: A cheeky line about bedroom furniture that turns into a brief fling.
explanation.definitionFit: A one-off sexual encounter is by nature never repeated, hence the exclamation.

clue.text: Rubber rings held by campaigners next to motorway

indicators.note: next to just places the motorway beside the rest
held by means the ring letters are gripped by the campaigners' letters

parts.note: CND is the Campaign for Nuclear Disarmament
each ring is round like the letter O, and the plural gives two of them
M is the abbreviation for a motorway, as in the M1

explanation.surface: Protesters with rubber rings camped beside a motorway.
explanation.walkthrough: 'rings' gives two O's, both held by CND: one after its C, one after its D. The parse can only show the second O standing alone. Rubber is US slang for the answer.
explanation.definitionFit: Rubber is American slang for a contraceptive sheath.

clue.text: Swinger didn't get called

parts.note: someone who didn't get anything got zero, the letter O
rang means telephoned or called

explanation.surface: A wife-swapper sulks at being left off the phone list.
explanation.definitionFit: The orang-utan is an ape that swings through the trees by its long arms.

clue.text: Writer comes after top journo over detail

indicators.note: comes after places the writer behind the other piece
over means turned over, so the letters of the editor are read backwards

parts.note: ED, the editor, is the top journalist on a paper
a scribe is a writer or copyist

explanation.surface: A newsroom pecking order where a reporter follows the editor's lead on the details.
explanation.definitionFit: To detail something is to set it out fully, which is to give an account of it.

clue.text: Yes, a film about insects

indicators.note: about here means moved around, so these letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: Someone confirms a documentary is about insects.
explanation.definitionFit: Mayflies are short-lived winged insects that hatch near water.

clue.text: How big top is making you upset

parts.note: a cap is the top of a bottle or jar
size says how big something is

explanation.surface: A circus tent's size is getting someone flustered.
explanation.walkthrough: 'big top' looks like a circus tent, but 'top' is the cap and 'How big' its size.
explanation.definitionFit: A boat that is upset has been overturned, the sense of tipping over in the water.

clue.text: He checks the blue pens qualify

indicators.note: to pen is to enclose, so the sky wraps round the other letters

parts.note: the blue is a poetic name for the sky
to pass an exam is to qualify

explanation.surface: A man inspects whether blue biros are up to standard.
explanation.walkthrough: 'checks' sounds like an inspector but means putting a king in check.
explanation.definitionFit: Boris Spassky was the Soviet world chess champion who lost to Fischer in 1972, so a man who gave check.

clue.text: These in stock? Sees at ground

indicators.note: ground as in crushed, so these letters are reduced and remade

explanation.surface: A shop asks whether a supporter's passes are available, as seen at the stadium.
explanation.walkthrough: 'ground' doubles as the football ground where these are used.
explanation.definitionFit: Passes valid for a whole run of matches, so a fan might ask whether they are in stock.

clue.text: Announced foundation course

indicators.note: announced means spoken out, so the word is taken by its sound

parts.note: a root is the base or foundation of something

explanation.surface: A college has declared a basic introductory course.
explanation.walkthrough: 'foundation course' reads as one phrase; split it.
explanation.definitionFit: A route is a way or path taken, the sense of a course travelled.

clue.text: Opening popular bit of summer course in Russia

parts.note: in means fashionable or popular
Aug, short for August, is part of the summer
the Ural is a river in Russia, a watercourse

explanation.surface: A popular first summer school run in Russia.
explanation.definitionFit: An inaugural event is the first of a series, so it is the opening one.

clue.text: IT-speak on the BBC, able to get translated

indicators.note: translated means put into a new form, so these letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: Computer jargon on the BBC that someone can render into plain English.
explanation.definitionFit: Impenetrable computer jargon is the typical example of baffling technical talk.

clue.text: Pay for return of issue once

parts.note: to atone is to pay for a wrong

indicators.note: return means going back, so the letters of issue are read in reverse

parts.note: to emit is to issue or send out

explanation.surface: A shopper settles up for a returned copy of a magazine just this once.
explanation.definitionFit: Formerly or at some point in the past is what once means here.

clue.text: Prize bull's a bit big

parts.note: a plum is a prize job or plum role
pish is nonsense, like bull; the 's stands for is and links

explanation.surface: An award-winning bull is somewhat on the large side.
explanation.definitionFit: Rather plump or somewhat fat, a slightly larger build.

clue.text: Worried about gonads, ie balls

indicators.note: about here means turned around, so these letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: Someone fretting about his testicles.
explanation.walkthrough: 'balls' is the surface's gloss on gonads and a link; 'about' signals the shuffle.
explanation.definitionFit: To be in anguish or tormented by worry is to be in agony over something.

clue.text: Act of authorising a goal line technology, initially, is complex

indicators.note: complex means intricate and tangled, so these letters are rearranged
initially takes the opening letter of technology

explanation.surface: Bringing in goal-line technology in football is a tricky business.
explanation.definitionFit: Making something lawful means officially authorising it.

clue.text: Bring up secretary's cleavage

parts.note: PA is a personal assistant, a secretary; the 's links
a rent is a split or tear, a cleavage

explanation.surface: A cheeky office remark about a secretary's neckline.
explanation.definitionFit: To raise a child is to act as its mother or father.

clue.text: Some privates switched positions

indicators.note: switched means swapped end for end, so the letters are read backwards

parts.note: a set is a position, as in the set of a sail, so two of them make positions

explanation.surface: Soldiers moved to new posts in the ranks.
explanation.walkthrough: Privates looks military but means private parts.
explanation.definitionFit: The male reproductive glands are among a man's private parts.

clue.text: Can early bet inform odds, when backing one to get up?

indicators.note: backing means going backwards, so the letters picked are read in reverse
odds asks for the odd-numbered letters of those words

explanation.surface: A punter wondering whether an early bet tips off the bookies when backing a horse to rise.
explanation.walkthrough: Taking the odd letters gives CNALBTNOM, and 'when backing' reverses them.
explanation.definitionFit: A mountain is something climbers ascend; the question mark flags this Alpine peak as an example.

clue.text: Note resounding upturns when there's no resistance

indicators.note: the phrase means a letter is taken away
in a down entry upturns means the letters are read from the bottom up

parts.note: reverb is a resounding echo effect
R is the symbol for resistance in physics

explanation.surface: A musical note echoes as volume swells once resistance vanishes.
explanation.walkthrough: Reversing REVERB gives BREVER, and dropping its final R leaves the answer.
explanation.definitionFit: A breve is a long musical note worth two semibreves.

clue.text: Please tell leader off

indicators.note: the leader is the first letter, and off means it is removed

parts.note: to relate is to tell a story

explanation.surface: Someone politely asks to inform the boss they're leaving.
explanation.definitionFit: To delight or make someone happy is to gladden them.

clue.text: Alternatively, ten said aid sent as I tend to fracture after separation

indicators.note: once each group is separated off, fracturing breaks its letters into a new order

explanation.surface: A tangle of muddled phrases, each a broken copy of the next.
explanation.walkthrough: 'aid sent' and 'as I tend' are two further jumbles of the same seven letters; any one of the three gives the answer.
explanation.definitionFit: Saying 'in place of that' offers an alternative, so the word works as an adverb meaning alternatively.

clue.text: Famous item in entrants' pockets

indicators.note: to pocket is to keep inside, so the answer is tucked within these words

explanation.surface: A celebrity's belonging goes into competitors' pockets.
explanation.definitionFit: Eminent means distinguished and well known, so famous.

clue.text: Cryptic crossword finally found in papers taken by woman

indicators.note: taken by means held inside the woman's letters

parts.note: hen is slang for a woman

indicators.note: found in means placed inside the papers

parts.note: ID, identity documents, are papers

indicators.note: finally takes the last letter of crossword

explanation.surface: A puzzle's last answer appears in a newspaper bought by a woman.
explanation.definitionFit: Something cryptic has its meaning concealed or obscure.

clue.text: Felt constituent's very large following when leading

indicators.note: following places this piece after the others

parts.note: as can mean when, as in 'as he arrived'
best means top or leading
OS stands for outsize, very large

explanation.surface: An emotional component of a very large win.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Felt' is not the past tense but the fabric; asbestos felt was used in roofing.
explanation.definitionFit: Asbestos fibre was a component of felt made for insulation and roofing.
